title: Service × City Intersection Facts
description: One record per (service, city) cell that needs premium treatment beyond the generic service template + shared city data merge. Contains local price bands (year-stamped, referencing price_layer.json slugs), local FAQ overrides/additions, local proof points, and neighborhood-specific notes. Generated by fusing services × cities + a per-cell research pass. Blueprint §2 item 3. File location: data/service_city_facts/<service-slug>--<city-slug>.json (double-dash separator).

service_slug.description: Service identifier. Must match a slug in data/services/.

city_slug.description: City identifier. Must match a slug in data/cities/.

created.description: ISO 8601 date when this record was first created.

updated.description: ISO 8601 date when this record was last updated.

local_price_band.description: Year-stamped local price ranges for this service in this city. References price_layer.json slugs for the canonical number; this provides the local band context.

year.description: Year this price band was verified. Stale after 12 months.

range_low.description: Low end of local price range in USD.

range_high.description: High end of local price range in USD.

source_note.description: How this price was verified (e.g., 'HomeAdvisor + local competitor quotes 2026-Q2').

price_layer_refs.description: Slugs in price_layer.json that this band contextualizes.

replaces_index.description: If set, replaces the FAQ at this index in the service-level faq_items. If unset, appends.

local_faq_overrides.description: City-specific FAQ overrides or additions to the service-level FAQ.

claim.description: Factual claim (e.g., 'FPE panels common in Mantua subdivision').

local_proof_points.description: Local proof points that add credibility to this service×city page.

note.description: Service-relevant note about this specific neighborhood.

neighborhood_notes.description: Neighborhood-specific notes for this service in this city.

cross_sell_context.description: City-specific context for cross-selling related services.

local_code_notes.description: Jurisdiction-specific code adoption notes (e.g., '2020 NEC, fireman's disconnect since 2021').
